classes.definition: It repeats on the same head with the same shape and names a code or config cause.

classes.retry: one automatic retry of the slot's failed test files, only when every failure matches a listed test-signature entry
classes.definition: It appears only in the multi-slot matrix, does not reproduce on its own, its shape is resource or timing contention, and its evidence shows it is unrelated to product semantics.

classes.retry: one manual rerun of the failed jobs at the same head; the in-workflow test retry never applies
classes.definition: The run failed before a test started, either while acquiring a runner or in a setup step, and the failed step's log carries a concrete environment error registered below.
discrimination: A test executed when one of the job's test steps started: `Unit and integration tests` in a `test (<node>)` slot; `UAT verification app tests`, `Agent skill and CI script tests` and `Testbed` in `check`; and the consumer matrix step in `consumers`. A `failure` of a test step is a test failure; a job that fails after a test step passed is unclassified (tests executed, no test failed); a `cancelled` test step is unclassified with the outcome unknown.
When the test steps are skipped, or the job has no steps at all, no test started. The first failed step must be job acquisition or a registered environment step.

The first failed step must match an infrastructure entry's `step`, and the job log must match its `patterns`. Without that match the failure is unclassified: it stays red, is not evidence, and is a defect to fix.
An infrastructure failure never turns the gate green and never counts as one of #25's three independent runs, whether the gate was red or green.

evidenceWindow.note: Committed runs of the spec workflow. One slot execution is one test (<node>) job of one run.

runs.detail: APP_NOT_OPEN inside the retried assertion, message "The native browser operation failed (scope-unavailable)"

evidence.notAProductDefect: In the runs where the rest of the matrix executed, the same test file passes in the sibling slots: in 42957099225, slots 22, 24, 24.8.0 and 26 all pass cdp-recovery.test.ts while 22.22.3 fails it. Twelve runs on seven different heads hit the signature in five matrix slots across four test files; the wrapped form (an APP_NOT_OPEN assertion carrying the same message) is the same native refusal, not an init-order or popup assertion about product behavior. The runner classifies a settled clean refusal: effects not-dispatched and scope usable, so nothing was dispatched twice and no page state was published from it. Each matrix slot gets its own 4-vCPU runner and runs three browser workers plus their app processes; a native scope going unavailable under that per-slot starvation is a transport-contention shape, not a single-user product path. It is not reproducible outside the matrix load.

entries.signature: `Set up source-pinned native runtime` fails in `agent-browser install --with-deps` after the archive mirror stops resolving: `Ign:` retries for the four noble suites, then `Temporary failure resolving 'azure.archive.ubuntu.com'` and `W: Failed to fetch mirror+file:/etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt/dists/noble/...`

runs.head: 7ac2a5eb8
runs.detail: Every one of the seven jobs skipped its test step (`Testbed`, `Run the reference consumer matrix with exact counts`, `Unit and integration tests`) and failed first in the native runtime setup; the log carries `Temporary failure resolving 'azure.archive.ubuntu.com'` twelve times. `install (11)`, `install (12)` and `native-runtime / build` passed in the same attempt, and attempt 1 of the same run at the same head was green in every job, including `spec gate`.

evidence.notAProductDefect: No test started, so no assertion, engine error, or test file is implicated. The same head's attempt 1 ran the whole matrix green, the source-pinned artifact was built and downloaded successfully in the failing attempt, and the failing step is the shared mirror's DNS resolution rather than a repository input. A run whose tests did not execute is not evidence about the change either way.

entries.automatedRetry: None: no test started, so there is no failed test file for the slot retry. Re-run the failed jobs once at the same head. If the rerun fails the same way, the one rerun is spent: investigate whether it is a repository input or an external outage and record the attempt as not evidence.
